Joint distribution of two statistics

Source: R/association.R
plot_joint.Rd

Where do players concentrate on two statistics at once? The two-dimensional kernel density is drawn as soft filled contours behind the players, with the marginal distributions on the edges, a few highlighted players labelled, and optional groups coloured.

Usage

plot_joint(
  data,
  x,
  y,
  label = NULL,
  highlight = NULL,
  xlab = x,
  ylab = y,
  x_labels = ggplot2::waiver(),
  y_labels = ggplot2::waiver(),
  title = NULL,
  subtitle = NULL,
  caption = NULL
)

Arguments

data

A data frame, one row per player (or team).

x, y

Column names.

label

Column with names.

highlight

Names to label and emphasise.

xlab, ylab, title, subtitle, caption

Labels.

x_labels, y_labels

Axis label functions, e.g. scales::label_percent().

Value

A patchwork object (needs the patchwork package).
